module.purpose: Implements thenable (promise) tracking and Suspense integration for React Flight server rendering, enabling synchronous unwrapping of fulfilled promises and suspension on pending ones.
module.summary: The module manages the lifecycle of thenables used in React's server-side rendering to support Suspense. It defines a ThenableState array that records thenables by index, attaches expando properties (status, value, reason) to thenables to synchronously unwrap them, and throws a special SuspenseException to interrupt rendering when a thenable is pending. A module-level variable captures the suspended thenable so the work loop can retrieve it after catching the exception.
module.businessContext: Part of React's SSR framework; enables Suspense for async data on server. Failure breaks streaming/SSR suspension and error propagation.
